Latest price: $103.774/bbl | Daily change: -0.95% | Date: November 3, 2026
"Brent crude fell more than 3% to below $102 a barrel on Tuesday, heading toward a four-week low" following President Trump's announcement to end U.S. financial support for Israel. Energy Secretary Chris Wright indicated that strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island had not disrupted oil flows, while Iran's leadership authorized diplomatic discussions on previously non-negotiable issues.
